name: histone deacetylase 4
pathways: negative regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II

function.text: HDAC4 encodes histone deacetylase 4. Annotated molecular activities include DNA-binding transcription activator activity and DNA-binding transcription factor binding. It participates in positive regulation of DNA-templated transcription and negative regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to neurodevelopmental disorder with central hypotonia and dysmorphic facies (autosomal dominant).

somatic.text: Somatic sequence alterations have cohort-level candidate-driver evidence in Thymoma. This gene-level statistical evidence requires allele-specific review and does not establish the effect of every variant.

germline_associations.mechanism: Autosomal dominant; strong GenCC assertion from Labcorp Genetics (formerly Invitae). Allele-specific mechanism requires review.

somatic_associations.mechanism: Cohort-level candidate sequence driver in IntOGen (combined q<0.1; at least 3 mutated samples). Statistical association does not classify an individual allele.
